title: The Bear Who Joined the Army 🐻 #shorts
cast: a big friendly brown bear with a small Polish army cap

lines.say: During World War Two, one army had a soldier who was a bear.
shots: {hero} standing on his hind legs saluting next to soldiers in a 1940s camp
close-up of {hero} grinning with a small army cap

lines.say: In 1942, Polish soldiers in Iran adopted a little orphan bear cub. They named him Wojtek.
shots: soldiers in a desert camp feeding a tiny bear cub from a bottle
the tiny cub sleeping in a soldier's helmet

lines.say: He grew up with the troops. He wrestled with them, drank from bottles, and slept beside them in their tents.
shots: {hero} play wrestling with laughing soldiers in the sand
{hero} sleeping in a big army tent between soldiers

lines.say: To bring him on a ship to Italy, the army made him an official soldier, with a name, rank and number.
shots: an officer stamping a document while {hero} watches curiously
{hero} walking up the ramp of a ship with soldiers

lines.say: At the Battle of Monte Cassino, soldiers said he helped carry heavy boxes of ammunition.
shots: {hero} carrying a wooden crate on his shoulder up a rocky mountain path

lines.say: His unit even made him their badge: a bear holding an artillery shell.
shots: a round army badge with a bear carrying a shell, embroidered, close-up
soldiers proudly wearing the bear badge on their sleeves

lines.say: After the war, Wojtek lived at Edinburgh Zoo, where old soldiers came to visit him.
shots: {hero} in a zoo enclosure in Scotland with green hills
old soldiers waving at {hero} from behind a fence

lines.say: Today there are statues of Wojtek in Scotland and Poland. Would you want a bear in your army?
shots: a bronze statue of a bear and a soldier in a city park

description:
Wojtek was a Syrian brown bear adopted by soldiers of the Polish II Corps in 1942, officially enlisted, and said to carry ammunition at Monte Cassino. He lived out his life at Edinburgh Zoo. A true story.

Sources: Imperial War Museums; Wikipedia: Wojtek (bear).

Made with AI-assisted pictures and voice.
